title: Jelly Jump
description: A jelly that can't stop bouncing, and a sky that never ends. Hop from biscuit to biscuit, catch a ride on the moving ones, hit a spring for a big launch, and stomp anything spiky. Wafer platforms crumble after one bounce, so don't hang about.
instructions: Left and right arrows or A/D to steer (the mouse works too). On a phone, hold the left or right side of the screen.
